messages:
maria: FYI — noticed a ~2k token provisional spike on the billing dashboard at 10:23 PT. seems correlated with a model-swap during an open streaming session :eyes:
kevin: can you share the query / logs you used to correlate?
maria: here's the quick telemetry query i ran (grafana ad-hoc):
```
select sum(tokens) as provisional_tokens, route, event_type
from telemetry.tokens
where event_time >= now() - interval '15 minutes'
group by route, event_type
order by provisional_tokens desc
```
kevin: looking at that, event_type `provisional_increment` spikes at the same time as `handoff.start`. but `handoff.finish` is missing for a bunch of sessions.
sasha: missing finish -> ledger never promoted provisional to confirmed. that would leave tokens tentative and then retries add another provisional?
elaine: also saw toolcall logs where a toolcall got truncated midstream and the client retried. two separate mechanisms could be adding provisional tokens: (1) router handoff left provisional, (2) client retry creates a new provisional session.
maria: pasted a sample log snippet: 
```
[2026-03-22T10:23:12Z] route=eu-west-1 session=abc123 event=handoff.start model_swap=llama-3b->llama-ev
[2026-03-22T10:23:13Z] route=eu-west-1 session=abc123 event=stream.chunk truncated=true
[2026-03-22T10:23:14Z] route=eu-west-1 session=abc123 event=client.retry reason=timeout
# no handoff.finish logged for session=abc123
```
kevin: so workflow: handoff.start allocates provisional tokens for resumed prefix, then client retry replays and router allocates provisional again for the new session id, causing double provisional charge before any confirm.
dan: is this the same class as the prefix-merge/ghost-token issues we've seen? seems related but the interaction with model swap + toolcall truncation is new.
sasha: agreed different vector. earlier prefix issues were about snapshot ownership across brokers; here the handshake sequence is interrupted and we never emit the confirm.
kevin: quick mitigation idea: on handoff.start emit a small TTL record and make subsequent retries dedupe on request provenance (x-session-origin header). if provenance matches and origin window < 10s, don't double-provision.
elaine: we could also make serving runtime emit `handoff.confirm` as soon as KV is stitched. that reduces the window where provisional state is ambiguous.
maria: for observability: propose adding a `handoff_state` label to tokens.* metrics (values: started, confirmed, orphaned). we'll get an immediate panel to show orphaned provisional tokens.
sasha: i can take the schema change — will add `tokens.provisional_count{handoff_state}` and a small tag on `route.*` metrics. opening PR now.
dan: UX/rollout note: mark the canary routes with `provisional-billing=true` flag so that billing alerts don't page for noisy canaries during the fix rollout.\e laine: (typo?)
elaine: lol meant to say "+1 to canary flag" :grimacing:
kevin: also add a one-off dashboard alert that fires if provisional > confirmed by > 1k tokens for > 2m. that should catch regressions quickly.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026 — "Provisional token spike during model-swap + retry"
telemetry-bot: CI job queued: telemetry-schema-change-PR42. will run integration tests.
maria: thanks — i'll monitor the incident and attach sample traces. follow-up: @sasha please link the PR and @kevin can you draft the router dedupe patch?
sasha: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/telemetry/pulls/42 — adds handoff_state label and new metric.
kevin: starting a small router patch branch now. will wire `x-session-origin` check and short dedupe window.
dan: schedule: patch + telemetry change -> roll to canary tonight, monitor dashboard for 1hr, then widen rollout if stable.
maria: thanks all. will update INC-2026 with traces and a short postmortem after rollout.
